about: Voice lab v1 (2026-10-09): same Muse video, current script vs a script written for the ear; current Kokoro vs Chatterbox (MIT) with emotion exaggeration. Owner listens and picks.
reference_text: Okay, this one genuinely surprised me. Meta just shipped an AI that does your chores, and honestly? It's kind of wild. Let me show you how it works.

current: Meta's new AI agent, Muse, doesn't just chat. It fills in forms, shops and books trips for you.
Here it found a field trip form in an email and filled it out for you.
It can shop too, but before it buys or sends anything, it asks first and logs every step.
It shot to number one on the App Store, with about {6.6|six point six} million installs in its first month.
The catch: it's US and Canada only, and WIRED reports it keeps a page on every person in your life. It's free to start, with weekly limits.
Would you let an AI run your inbox? Comment {AGENT|agent}.

ear.text: Meta just dropped an AI that actually does your chores.
It's called Muse. You text it, and it fills out forms, shops, even books your trips.
Watch. It found a school form in an email... and filled it out. By itself.
And before it buys anything? It asks you first.
It's already the number one app in America. Six point six million installs. In one month!
But here's the catch. It only works in the US and Canada.
And WIRED says it keeps a file on everyone in your life.
So... would you let an AI run your inbox? Comment agent.
